in_arabic.name: عبيدة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من عبد الله، يعني العبد أو الخادم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عبيدة مشتق من الجذر العربي (عبد) الذي يعني الخضوع أو العبودية، و هو اسم يدل على التوحيد و الخضوع لله. في القرآن الكريم، نجد أن عبيدة هو اسم أحد الصحابة، و هو اسم ذو دلالة دينية و تاريخية كبيرة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: عبیدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبیدہ نام کی اصلیت عربی زبان میں ہے، جو (عبد) کے جذر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خضوع یا عبادت۔ یہ نام اللہ کی عبادت اور توحید کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے مابین، یہ نام احترام اور دینی تفاخر کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उबैदा
in_hindi.long_meaning: उबैदा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जो 'अब्द' मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है परमात्मा की सेवा या भक्ति। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है, और इसे एक पवित्र और सम्मानित नाम माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عبیده
in_pashto.long_meaning: د عبیده نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چی د (عبد) په معنی د خضوع یا د خداوند بنده. دا نوم د افغانستان او پاکستان په پښتون ټولنه کې د دیني او کلتوري احترام سره ګورئ. دا نوم د توحید او د خداوند د عبادت دلالت کوي.

in_english.name: Ubayda
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ubayda originates from the Arabic root 'abd', meaning worship or servitude. It signifies a person devoted to God's service. Historically, Ubayda was the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's companions. The name carries significant spiritual and cultural weight in Islamic tradition, symbolizing humility and devotion to Allah. Across Muslim cultures, Ubayda is a name that reflects a strong religious identity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ubayda reflects a rich Islamic history and cultural significance rooted in the virtue of jihad, or striving in the way of Allah. Ubayda is an Arabic name that has been borne by numerous figures in Islamic history, from companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the early Islamic era to renowned scholars, soldiers, and leaders throughout history. This name represents bravery, courage, and dedication, as individuals named Ubayda have contributed significantly to the Islamic world through their military prowess, intellectual pursuits, and spiritual devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The Islamic name Ubayda holds profound spiritual significance as it reflects a deep commitment to upholding the principles of Islam and striving for righteousness in all aspects of life. This name is a reminder that every believer is called upon to serve and fight for the cause of Allah, not only through physical struggle, but also through acts of worship, simplicity, and kindness. As the name Ubayda reminds us, we are all soldiers in the service of the Almighty, and our spiritual journey is an ongoing battlefield where we continually seek to please Allah and grow in righteousness. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Ubayda is one of selflessness, devotion, and dedication to Allah and His way.
